promise: NEW YORKERS is sold in named releases. Nothing is ever added to a release once it closes, and no New Yorker is ever sold twice. Most releases are sized and closed before they open. KEYSTONE is the exception and says so on its face: it is open ended by design, it stands at 111 today, and it grows as new Keystone New Yorkers are painted. The census is still being painted, so more releases will follow, and every one is announced in advance, the same way.
promiseShort: Sold in named releases, and no New Yorker sold twice. Most are closed before they open. KEYSTONE is open ended and says so.
expansion: This is an evolving series. New eras are still being painted, and the city keeps nominating people who are not in it yet. When a release is announced it says exactly what is in it, how many, in what format, on what platform and when. Nothing is ever quietly added to something you already bought into.
note: KEYSTONE is open now on Transient Labs. THE CENSUS RELEASE is minting now on OpenSea, from Wednesday September 23, 11:11 AM ET until Friday October 23, 11:11 AM ET. Prices below are what each release actually opened at.

releases.name: THE MARKS
releases.drawnFrom: Every painted number divisible by one hundred, plus the closing number of every era. Era I is not included.
releases.subseries: The hundred marks and the era closers
releases.when: Waves run from late September. Dates announced one at a time.
releases.detail: Eighteen era closers go to SuperRare as a monthly series. Seventy two hundred marks go to Transient Labs in six waves. Every era painted after this one adds six more marks, and those belong to a later release, never to this one.
releases.price: Hundred marks $345 flat. Era closers by auction with a published reserve.

releases.name: KEYSTONE
releases.countNote: 111 and counting. This release grows as new Keystone New Yorkers are painted.
releases.drawnFrom: The founding NEW YORKERS: the Era I leads, the Mythos spine and the threads that hold the census together. The first 111 are the ones the whole city is built on.
releases.format: Dynamic ones of one on Transient Labs ERC-7160TL. The token holds a stack of finished states, the artist appends variants and new art over time, and the owner pins the one that shows.
releases.detail: This release replaces THE ONES and merges it in. THE ONES was published as 150 pieces in fifteen monthly chapters on SuperRare with a rising price ladder. That structure is gone. KEYSTONE is one open release on one contract at one price, and it is the only release here that is not sized and closed before it opens. Every piece is unique, one owner each, and because the contract is ERC-7160 the art inside a piece keeps growing after you own it. Nothing already made is ever deleted, and no New Yorker in this release appears in THE CENSUS RELEASE.
releases.price: 0.069 ETH each. One price, no ladder.

releases.name: THE CENSUS RELEASE
releases.drawnFrom: Drawn across eras II to XIX so no era is emptied, with every family, every borough and every set represented, and excluding the hundred and fifty in THE ONES.
releases.format: THE CENSUS RELEASE mints on OpenSea as a standard token. A census New Yorker can then be evolved into a dynamic ERC-7160 New Yorker holding several variants, and the artist keeps adding to it.
releases.when: Wednesday September 23, 11:11 AM ET, until Friday October 23, 11:11 AM ET.
releases.detail: Era I is excluded because it paints real public figures. Pieces promised back to the people who nominated them are excluded, and so is every piece in THE ONES. Nothing in this release is ever reopened or topped up.
releases.price: About $11 a piece, priced in ETH so the dollar figure moves, in one public window that runs thirty days.

future.headline: More will follow
future.body: The census is not finished and was never meant to be. Eras are still being painted, nominations arrive every week, and one is chosen every Sunday. Work that is not in a named release is not for sale yet, and it is not being held back forever either. It is simply not its turn.
